declarations.type:
∀ {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space} {D P : ℝ},
  Breakdown.Coercive.SolenoidalModeHolds →
    Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.IsWeakSecondDerivState W HW D →
      ∀ {v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space},
        Breakdown.Coercive.IsSmoothPerturbation P v →
          ∀ (Q : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
            Breakdown.Coercive.IsSolenoidalPartOf (Breakdown.Coercive.smoothRight P W v) Q →
              MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => (fderiv ℝ (W z.1) z.2) (v z.1 z.2)) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                (Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic fun σ y => (fderiv ℝ (W σ) y) (v σ y)) ∧
                  (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖(fderiv ℝ (W σ) y) (v σ y)‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ ∧
                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                        (fun z => Breakdown.Coercive.smoothRight P W v z.1 z.2 - (fderiv ℝ (W z.1) z.2) (v z.1 z.2))
                        MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                      (Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic fun σ y =>
                          Breakdown.Coercive.smoothRight P W v σ y - (fderiv ℝ (W σ) y) (v σ y)) ∧
                        (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                              ‖Breakdown.Coercive.smoothRight P W v σ y - (fderiv ℝ (W σ) y) (v σ y)‖ ^ 2) <
                            ⊤ ∧
                          ∃ Q',
                            Breakdown.Coercive.IsSolenoidalPartOf (fun σ y => (fderiv ℝ (W σ) y) (v σ y)) Q' ∧
                              ∀ᵐ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                                Q z.1 z.2 =
                                  Breakdown.Coercive.smoothRight P W v z.1 z.2 - (fderiv ℝ (W z.1) z.2) (v z.1 z.2) +
                                    (2 • Q' z.1 z.2 - (fderiv ℝ (W z.1) z.2) (v z.1 z.2))

                Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.IsWeakSecondDerivState W HW D →
                  (∃ B, ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w y ≤ B) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin k), MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => act i z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                      (∀ (i : Fin k), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (act i)) →
                        (∀ (i : Fin k), (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖act i σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤) →

                            (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                            (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (u : ℕ → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
                              Breakdown.Coercive.IsSmoothApproximation P v G H g u →
                                ∃ φ,

                                    Filter.Tendsto
                                        (fun n =>
                                          ∫⁻ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1,
                                            ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                              Breakdown.Coercive.splitRight
                                                (fun σ y ι =>
                                                  Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.pieceRestWith m h w W HW (u (φ n))
                                                    (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n)))
                                                    (Breakdown.secondDerivField (u (φ n))) ι σ y)
                                                (fun σ y =>
                                                  Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.Internal.PieceDensityPassageWeak.pieceBlockLower
                                                    m W HW (u (φ n)) (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n)))
                                                    (Breakdown.secondDerivField (u (φ n))) σ y)
                                                (Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.stretchFormWith W HW (u (φ n))
                                                  (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n))))
                                                σ y)
                                        Filter.atTop
                                        (nhds
                                          (∫⁻ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1,
                                            ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                              Breakdown.Coercive.splitRight
                                                (fun σ y ι =>
                                                  Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.pieceRestWith m h w W HW v G H ι σ y)
                                                (fun σ y =>
                                                  Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.Internal.PieceDensityPassageWeak.pieceBlockLower
                                                    m W HW v G H σ y)
                                                (Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.stretchFormWith W HW v G) σ y)) ∧
                                      ∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 1),
                                        ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                          Breakdown.Coercive.splitLeft
                                              (fun σ y ι => Breakdown.Coercive.piecePos m P v G ι σ y)
                                              (fun σ y ι => Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.pieceRestWith m h w W HW v G H ι σ y)
                                              (fun σ y =>
                                                Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.Internal.PieceDensityPassageWeak.pieceBlockLower
                                                  m W HW v G H σ y)
                                              (Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.stretchFormWith W HW v G) σ y ≤
                                            Filter.liminf
                                              (fun n =>
                                                Breakdown.Coercive.splitLeft
                                                  (fun σ y ι =>
                                                    Breakdown.Coercive.piecePos m P (u (φ n))
                                                      (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n))) ι σ y)
                                                  (fun σ y ι =>
                                                    Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.pieceRestWith m h w W HW (u (φ n))
                                                      (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n)))
                                                      (Breakdown.secondDerivField (u (φ n))) ι σ y)
                                                  (fun σ y =>
                                                    Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.Internal.PieceDensityPassageWeak.pieceBlockLower
                                                      m W HW (u (φ n)) (Breakdown.gradField (u (φ n)))
                                                      (Breakdown.secondDerivField (u (φ n))) σ y)
                                                  (Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.stretchFormWith W HW (u (φ n))

  {w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ} {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {D w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ} {v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space},
  Breakdown.Coercive.ModeSquareSumHolds →
    Breakdown.Coercive.SmoothPerturbationIsPerturbationHolds →
      Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.IsAdmissibleWeak m P h w W HW w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
        Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.IsWeakSecondDerivState W HW D →
          Breakdown.Coercive.IsSmoothPerturbation P v →
            ∀ (β : Fin nE),
              ∀ᵐ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space) ∂Breakdown.Coercive.Internal.PieceAbsorb.slabMeasure,
                ∃ c,
                  (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                      Breakdown.PieceWeights.inPiece (m.epsP β).modes ι →
                        √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                              (Breakdown.modeVel ι (Breakdown.Coercive.Internal.SmoothPieceEpsCore.stretchRest W v) z.1
                                  z.2 -
                                c ι)) ≤
                          Breakdown.Coercive.edgeSum h (m.epsP β).modes
                            (fun α => Breakdown.Coercive.gradAmp (Breakdown.gradField W) α z.1 z.2)
                            (fun κ => Breakdown.Coercive.vortAmp (Breakdown.gradField v) κ z.1 z.2) ι) ∧
                    (Summable fun ι =>
                        (Complex.I * ↑(Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.epsP β).modes ι * (m.epsP β).wt z.2) *
                            Breakdown.cdot (Breakdown.Coercive.Internal.SmoothPieceEpsCore.vortMode v ι z.1 z.2)
                              (c ι)).re) ∧
                      |∑' (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                            (Complex.I * ↑(Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.epsP β).modes ι * (m.epsP β).wt z.2) *
                                Breakdown.cdot (Breakdown.Coercive.Internal.SmoothPieceEpsCore.vortMode v ι z.1 z.2)
                                  (c ι)).re| ≤
                        (m.epsP β).wt z.2 * (1 / 2 * Breakdown.Coercive.vortSup W z.2) *
                          (Breakdown.Coercive.pieceNorm (m.epsP β).modes fun κ =>
                              Breakdown.Coercive.vortAmp (Breakdown.gradField v) κ z.1 z.2) ^
                            2

    ∀ {B : ℝ},
      (∀ (s : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ‖fderiv ℝ (W s) y‖ ≤ B) →
        Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic W →
          ∀ (s : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),
            (∀ α ∈ s, -α ∈ s) →
              (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space) (i : Fin 3),
                  (W σ y).ofLp i = (Breakdown.modeVel (0, 0) W σ y i).re + ∑ α ∈ s, (Breakdown.modeVel α W σ y i).re) →
                ∀ (σ τ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space) (i j : Fin 3),
                  ↑((Breakdown.axialRot (-φ)
                            ((fderiv ℝ (W (σ + τ)) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))
                              (Breakdown.axialRot φ (Breakdown.unitVector j)))).ofLp
                        i) =
                    ↑(((fderiv ℝ (Breakdown.meanField W) y) (Breakdown.unitVector j)).ofLp i) +
                      ∑ α ∈ s,
                        Complex.exp (↑(2 * Real.pi * ↑α.1 * τ + ↑α.2 * φ) * Complex.I) *
